$ATTREQ.meaning: 0 assumes attribute defaults; 1 prompts for attribute values as specified by ATTDIA.

implementation.dxfOutput: HEADER preflight validates canonical dollar/bare aliases, integer variant type, group code 70, and each documented 0/1 domain only when the selected target is below AC1012, matching the existing writer emission branch. Invalid legacy values are refused atomically; tolerant input remains unchanged.
implementation.nonEmittingTargets: AC1012, AC1014, and AC1027 generated controls verify that these variables are neither rejected nor emitted when the writer does not persist them.
implementation.semanticLimit: Scalar admission and legacy header transport only; no native INSERT, prompt, or attribute-editing behavior is qualified.

coverage: AC1009 ASCII output and typed readback for all documented ATTDIA/ATTREQ values.
